items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: And he taught me this step.

ctx.x: He -- we were backstage. I was asking Chuckles a question. I was asking Slim a question about how should I do that step or which --which number were we going to do first, see. We used to dance by "Sweet Sue" and "Broadway Melody." And if we had to do an encore, we would do the "Bugle Call Rag," because Slim, he liked the way I danced that, you know, because he had taught me a few of the steps in the "Bugle Call Rag," how you're supposed to do it.

And so while I was asking him this question, Mr. Buddy Bradley happened to come by, and he says, he explained to me how you do a step, a certain step and some kind of tap strut, you know. And he had the Tack Annie in it, what they call Tack Annie.

And he taught me this step. By the way, Mr. Peg Leg Bass was in this show too. He was there. So it was just a fortune, you know. I think it was a blessing to meet all these great people, you see. And he says who he was and so on and so forth. And I says, "Oh, you're the man in the picture," you know. And he laughed. He liked children, see, Mr. Bradley, Buddy Bradley.
